text: 金十数据8月31日讯，今日早盘，三大指数低开后震荡回升，盘尾回落。截至中午收盘，上证指数收跌0.20%，深证成指收跌1.00%，创业板指收跌1.29%。AI语料板块震荡走高，芒果超媒、荣信文化双双20cm涨停，中广天择、上海电影等多股涨停；煤炭开采板块盘中拉升，郑州煤电涨停，大有能源涨超6%；房地产服务板块活跃，特发服务涨超10%；液冷服务器板块走强，金富科技、金帝股份、康盛股份等多股涨停；除此以外，消费电子、体育、厨卫电器、银行、PCB等板块涨幅居前。房地产开发板块高开低走，香江控股、盈新发展等多股跌超5%；除此以外，贵金属、创新药、有色金属、航空机场
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 31 - This morning, the three major indices opened lower, rebounded, then pulled back at the close. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.20%, the Shenzhen Component fell 1.00%, and the ChiNext fell 1.29%. The AI corpus sector rose steadily, with Mango Excellent Media and Rongxin Culture both hitting 20cm limit-up, and Zhongguang Tianze and Shanghai Film among multiple limit-ups. The coal mining sector lifted intraday, with Zhengzhou Coal Power hitting limit-up and Dayou Energy up over 6%. Real estate services were active, with Tefa Service up over 10%. Liquid-cooled server stocks strengthened, with Jinfu Technology, Jindi Shares and Kangsheng Shares among multiple limit-ups. Additionally, consumer electronics, sports, kitchen and bathroom appliances, banks and PCB sectors led gains. The real estate development sector opened high and fell, with Xiangjiang Holding and Yingxin Development down over 5%.
